title: Separate Black and White Balls
sourceKind: secondary mirror (leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/2938); official page not retrievable
summary: Balls are '0' (white) or '1' (black). Each step swaps two adjacent balls; return the minimum steps to put all white balls on the left and black balls on the right.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps s at 50 characters. One search result labels this problem #3195; the title and most sources use 2938, so the number is unresolved on that one source.
